answer: Agents bond stake to an epoch-specific identity commitment and prove, without disclosure, that each message carries a valid polynomial evaluation and rate-limit nullifier. Reusing a quota slot with distinct challenges exposes two Shamir shares, from which the private key can be reconstructed; the verifier then slashes the bond immediately. The nadir, jade, and dune labels may distinguish epochs or test vectors, but do not weaken this privacy-bound enforcement.
